keyChanges.title: Terafab Construction Accelerating: Drone Footage Confirms Excavation, GeoPiers, and Site Leveling Already Underway
keyChanges.description: On August 13, 2026, independent drone footage captured by Tesla construction monitor Joe Tegtmeyer (with Tesla flight approval) revealed that Terafab construction is well underway at the Grimes County site. The footage shows active earthmoving operations, excavation work in the northern section, GeoPiers installation, and leveling/fill work in the central area where the main factory foundation will be laid. This represents a 7-day acceleration beyond the August 6 groundbreaking announcement—construction has moved from 'starting almost immediately' (per August 5-6 community meeting statements) to visibly active mobilization. Terafab representative Riley Trennell stated civil work and foundation prep would begin almost immediately after JETI tax agreements were signed (early August), and the drone footage confirms that timeline is being met. The facility remains on track for commercial operations in Q1 2029.

positive_signals: Drone footage from August 13 shows active excavation and earthmoving operations already visible
GeoPiers installation documented in northern section of site
Foundation leveling and gravel base work confirmed in central area
Rapid transition from permitting (July 26) to active civil work (August 13) demonstrates execution pace
Independent verification via aerial monitoring by Joe Tegtmeyer with Tesla flight approval
Timeline adherence: JETI signed early August, construction visible by August 13—7-day acceleration
Construction activity aligns with stated 'almost immediately' timeline from August 5-6 community meeting
negative_signals: Foundation work is still early-stage civil; fabrication tools, process qualification, and wafer production remain 2+ years away
Q1 2029 target is still 2.5+ years away; multi-phase build-out extends well beyond 2029
Drone footage shows only ground-level preparation; no major structural progress yet
Total project cost ($119B across four phases) indicates execution risk remains significant

keyChanges.title: Terafab Community Meeting: JETI Tax Agreements Confirmed Active, $20M Annual Payment to County Locked In
keyChanges.description: On August 5-6, 2026, SpaceX and Terafab representatives held their first public meeting with Grimes County residents in the Commissioners Court. The meeting confirmed that JETI (Jobs and Exports Texas Incentive) tax abatement agreements with Iola ISD and Anderson-Shiro CISD are officially signed and active. SpaceX attorney Buck Brannon clarified that SpaceX's abatement is approximately 78% (not 100% as some reports suggested), with SpaceX committing to pay Grimes County a fixed $20 million annually for 35 years (total: $710 million). The county had already received a $10 million payment from SpaceX earlier in the week, satisfying a milestone deadline in the tax abatement agreement signed in June. Terafab representative Riley Trennell stated that civil work and foundation preparation are starting 'almost immediately,' with renderings potentially released within days and full construction beginning 'within months.' The company addressed environmental concerns, stating Terafab will not raise local electric bills, deplete local water supplies, or draw down the Navasota River. Governor Abbott's office confirmed support via public release on August 6.

positive_signals: JETI tax agreements with both Iola ISD and Anderson-Shiro CISD confirmed signed and active
SpaceX $10 million payment to Grimes County received before deadline, satisfying contract milestone
$20 million annual payment commitment for 35 years ($710 million total) ensures long-term county revenue
Tax abatement percentage (78%) clarified by SpaceX legal counsel, showing transparency
Governor Greg Abbott's office issued public release confirming state-level support
School district tax abatements locked in; no further board votes required
Official project timeline ('almost immediately' civil work, 'within months' full construction) stated publicly
negative_signals: Initial reports suggested 100% abatement; actual 78% is materially lower tax benefit
Environmental concerns (water depletion, electric grid impact, river drawdown) raised at county meeting, requiring company assurances
No new timeline details beyond 'within months' for construction start and Q1 2029 commercial operations
Community opposition and concerns voiced at meeting (details not fully reported but implied by company need to provide assurances)

categoryUpdate.latestStatus: Terafab construction is actively underway as of August 13, 2026, with ground preparation, excavation, and GeoPiers installation visible in drone footage. All political/tax approvals (JETI agreements, school board tax abatements) are signed and active. Project remains on track for Q1 2029 commercial operations start.
categoryUpdate.nextMilestone: Main structural work and foundation completion (expected within 12-18 months); tool installation and process qualification (2027-2028); first wafer production (~Q1 2029)
concerns: Total project cost ($119B across four phases) and multi-phase timeline remain massive execution risks
Community opposition and environmental concerns (water, power, river usage) may surface during permitting process
No specific tool procurement or equipment delivery timeline announced
Q1 2029 target is aggressive for a 100M+ sq ft vertically integrated fab facility
Geopolitical and supply chain risks for semiconductor manufacturing equipment (ASML, Applied Materials, etc.)
